title_en: The Charm of Classical Chinese Poetry
note_en: 起来 after a verb often has nothing to do with "getting up." In 读起来有一种音乐般的节奏感 it means "when you read it" — how something comes across once you try it (cf. 看起来 "looks," 听起来 "sounds"). In 逐渐流行起来 it marks the start of a process: "gradually caught on." English handles both ideas with completely different words, so learn 起来 by its function, not its literal meaning.
